- `DEFAULT_RESPONSE_CONTENT_TYPE = 'text/plain;charset=UTF-8'`

- `resolveResponseMimeType(contentType)` — parses to a MIME object; `essence` is `'text/plain'` for `null`/`undefined` (via `parseMimeType`, which defaults to `text/plain`).

**`packages/api-client/src/v2/blocks/response-block/helpers/resolve-response-body-handler.ts`**
